aesKeysHint: The device address is the manufacturer code plus the device ID, e.g. AAA-12345678. A key is either 32 hex characters or a 16 character plain text key.
blocklistHint: Telegrams of the listed devices are ignored completely. Enter the device address, e.g. AAA-12345678.
Check for new devices that need a key: Check for new devices that need a key
ignoreUnknownDevicesHelp: Telegrams of devices that do not have an object tree yet are ignored, so no new devices are created. A device deleted from the object tree stays gone.
importNeedsKeyAdded: Added %s device(s) that need a key
importNeedsKeyConfirm: Adds devices the adapter has found without a usable key and that are not in the list yet, with a placeholder key. Nothing is saved: fill in the keys and save when you are done. This does not update by itself - devices found later need another click.
importNeedsKeyNothing: No device is waiting for a key
keysIgnoredHint: The option "Only handle devices that already have an object tree" is switched on: telegrams of devices without one are dropped, so no device can be waiting for a key. Switch it off to set up a new meter.
manufacturerSpecificEditorHint: The "JSON editor" button below opens the descriptions - with syntax highlighting and checking.
manufacturerSpecificExampleInserted: An example for a meter of the manufacturer XXX was inserted - replace XXX with the code of your meter, the three letters in front of its device id
manufacturerSpecificHint: Some meters pack values the standard does not describe into a manufacturer specific data record. Describe the bytes and bits of such a blob here and the adapter writes its values as states of their own - one description per manufacturer code, the three letters of the device address. A description here replaces the one the parser ships for that manufacturer. The name of a state is derived from the description of its field, so "legacyName" is worth setting for every value you want to keep: it pins the state id even when the text changes.
manufacturerSpecificNoTelegram: Enter a telegram as hex first
manufacturerSpecificPreviewOk: Decoded - %s value(s) came from a manufacturer specific record
manufacturerSpecificTelegramHelp: Paste a telegram here to see what the descriptions above would make of it. Nothing is saved and no state is written - it is only decoded.
